title: Adhyaya 7: Classical Duties & Dharma
summary: Canonical verses on traditional righteousness from Adhyaya 7.
ai_summary: Exposition of ethical conduct and cosmic law according to Sage Manu in Adhyaya 7.

verses.original: दण्डः शास्ति प्रजाः सर्वा दण्ड एवाभिरक्षति । दण्डः सुप्तेषु जागर्ति दण्डं धर्मं विदुर्बुधाः ॥
verses.transliteration: daṇḍaḥ śāsti prajāḥ sarvā daṇḍa evābhirakṣati | daṇḍaḥ supteṣu jāgarti daṇḍaṁ dharmaṁ vidurbudhāḥ ||
verses.translation: The rod of justice (Danda) governs all citizens; Danda alone protects them; Danda watches awake while people sleep; the wise declare Danda to be Dharma personified.

layers.author: medhatithi
layers.content: The philosophy of governance and law enforcement: impartial justice is the guardian of civilized life.

layers.author: kulluka-bhatta
layers.content: कुल्लूक भट्ट भाष्य: The rod of justice (Danda) governs all citizens; Danda alone protects them; Danda watches awake while people sleep; the wise declare Danda to be Dharma personified.

layers.author: buhler
layers.author_label: Sacred Books of the East Vol 25
layers.content: मनुस्मृती अध्याय 7: The philosophy of governance and law enforcement: impartial justice is the guardian of civilized life.

verses.original: यथा राजा तथा प्रजा इति लोकप्रसिद्धम् । राजा धर्मस्य गोप्ता वै प्रजानां परिपालकः ॥
verses.transliteration: yathā rājā tathā prajā iti lokaprasiddham | rājā dharmasya goptā vai prajānāṁ paripālakaḥ ||
verses.translation: As is the ruler, so are the citizens — this is renowned across the world. The king is the protector of Dharma and the benevolent guardian of his people.

layers.author: medhatithi
layers.content: The moral obligation of leadership to govern with benevolence, accountability, and righteousness.

layers.author: kulluka-bhatta
layers.content: कुल्लूक भट्ट भाष्य: As is the ruler, so are the citizens — this is renowned across the world. The king is the protector of Dharma and the benevolent guardian of his people.

layers.author: buhler
layers.author_label: Sacred Books of the East Vol 25
layers.content: मनुस्मृती अध्याय 7: The moral obligation of leadership to govern with benevolence, accountability, and righteousness.
